blocks.text: Actor and singer-songwriter Wilbert Ross brings star power to Cebu in a special celebration for his contract signing with Enshop Gadgets on November 12, 2026, marking a new beginning in his journey as their official brand ambassador. Dubbed as the Nation’s Langga, Wilbert Ross now ventures in a new path with this partnership, solidifying future collaborations that allows the gadget store to continue to expand its presence and strengthen its connection with customers.
